answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks room to reorient safely by extending east in level, accelerating flight away from B0100 and the missiles to the northwest, then initiating a hard left reversal after opening separation; retaining its missile and altitude supports repositioning rather than a committed attack or close missile evasion.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to spoil B01001’s engagement geometry while preserving escape speed by sustaining a descending, strongly banked east-to-northeast maneuver, as the missile from B0100 closes from behind and converges toward A0200’s altitude without any observed offensive expenditure or turn back toward B0100.
